title: Purana sona bechne par poora paisa kyun nahi milta
hooks: Purana sona bech rahe ho? Ye 3 galtiyan paisa kaat leti hain.
Sona becha par poora paisa nahi mila? Ye raaz jaan lo.
Gold exchange karne ja rahe ho? Pehle ye 3 deductions dekh lo.
hook_why: Direct mistake warning with specific number (3 galtiyan) matches top-performing Finance Fuel pattern and rival data showing 'PURANE SONE...' as high-retention opener.
metaphor: A gold ornament being peeled layer by layer — hallmark stamp, stone weight, solder joints, making charges — each layer revealing a deduction until only pure gold value remains.
mechanism: Stone weight separated and valued separately
Net weight × current MCX rate × purity % = gold value
Making charges never returned on resale
GST only on exchange difference, not cash sale

caption:
Purana sona bech rahe ho? Ye 3 galtiyan paisa kaat leti hain.

1. Making charges wapas nahi milte
2. Stone weight alag hota hai
3. Solder pe 1-3% deduction

Hallmark check karo, XRF test maango, 2-3 jewellers compare karo.

Source: BIS Hallmarking Regulations 2021, Gold Mart Jewellers guide
Save karo, kaam aayega 📌

Tumne kab purana sona becha tha? Comment mein batao.

#personalfinance #financeinhindi #moneytips #gold #hallmark #bis #oldgold #jewellery

claims.claim: Making charges are not returned when selling old gold for cash
claims.basis: Gold Mart Jewellers guide: 'Making charges aapne originally making charges diye the — sell karte waqt woh nahi milte. Sirf gold ki value milti hai.'

claims.claim: Stone weight is deducted and valued separately
claims.basis: Gold Mart Jewellers guide: 'Stone weight agar piece mein stones hain to unka weight alag kiya jaata hai — stones ki alag valuation hoti hai.'
Gold Mart Jewellers guide: 'Impurity / Solder Deduction... Typically 1–3% deducted.'

claims.claim: Final value = Net gold weight × Today's gold rate × Purity %
claims.basis: Gold Mart Jewellers guide: 'Final value = Net gold weight × Today's gold rate × Purity %'

claims.claim: GST applies only on exchange difference, not on cash sale of old gold
claims.basis: Gold Mart Jewellers guide: 'Jab aap purana sona bechte hain, GST aap pe nahi lagta — GST tab lagta hai jab aap naya jewellery khareedte hain ya exchange karte hain.'

claims.claim: BIS hallmark confirms purity; XRF test is non-destructive
claims.basis: Gold Mart Jewellers guide: 'BIS hallmark se confirm hoti hai purity... Reputable jewellers use a karat testing machine (XRF machine) — ek non-destructive test jo exact purity batata hai.'

steps_learned: Making charges are never refunded — only gold rate is paid
Stones weight is separated and valued separately
Final payout formula: net weight × today's MCX rate × purity percentage
GST applies only on exchange, not on cash sale
Checklist: verify hallmark, ask for XRF test, compare 2–3 jewellers
missing_steps: What MCX rate is and how it differs from the jeweller's buying rate

What 'net weight' means (gross weight minus stone weight)
How the 1–3% solder/joint deduction is actually calculated
What an XRF test is and why it's more reliable than touchstone
What a BIS hallmark looks like (logo, purity mark, jeweller code, year)
